8.7.2.3 Port Interfaces
There are two different interfaces to indicate changes in the Supervision Status to
interested SW-Cs / CDDs and the RTE.
The interface WdgM_LocalMode is used to signal the Local Supervision Status of a
single Supervised Entity.

The interface WdgM_GlobalMode is used to signal the Global Supervision Status that
is combined from all individual Supervised Entities.

The reason for defining two different interfaces is the way these interfaces are used.
For the WdgM_GlobalMode interfaces the Watchdog Manager module provides only
one single port with that interface. By contrast, for the WdgM_LocalMode interface the
Watchdog Manager module provides as many ports as there are Supervised Entities.
In order to access these ports efficiently, the Indirect Port API of the RTE can be used.
This API provides a list of all ports that have the same interface, e.g.:
